title: Death Prophecy
next_chapter_hook: In that instant when the shadowy figure was about to turn around, a sharp sword aura descended from the heavens, shattering this gaze that spanned across time and space—Su Qingyao's voice rang out like shattering ice: 'Chen Ji, you seek death!'

text.content:
Within the Mental Sea, everything collapsed.

Chen Ji felt himself dragged into the abyss by an irresistible force. The surrounding scenery shattered like a glass mirror, with cracks spreading and rendering everything into nothingness. He wanted to struggle, but his limbs were locked by some ancient will. Only his consciousness continued to race frantically.

'So this is... the death prophecy of Chapter 700?' he screamed within his heart, his voice fragmented and devoured by an invisible barrier.

The information leaking from the seal fissure surged like a catastrophic flood, crashing against his divine soul with destructive force. Each prophecy fragment was like a poisoned blade, slicing through the calm facade he had meticulously maintained for seven hundred chapters.

The scene gradually grew clearer.

He saw himself—or rather, saw a corpse lying in a pool of blood. That corpse's face was identical to his own, except its eyes were wide open, pupils reflecting a profound darkness beyond comprehension. A bowl-sized hole in its chest gushed blood continuously, dyeing the blue stone ground beneath it crimson.

The surrounding scenery... was at the junction of the three great sects. A crack stretching ten thousand miles had torn open in the heavens above, and some transcendent will could be vaguely seen watching the mortal realm from within that fissure.

The spiritual energy fluctuation in the air made Chen Ji instantly determine—this place was positioned at the eye of some massive formation.

But what terrified him most was the figure standing beside his own corpse.

That person had their back to him, their form shrouded in a thin layer of mist. No matter how desperately Chen Ji tried to see clearly, he could only catch fragmented outlines—slender fingers, draping robes, and a faint, ethereal fragrance.

That fragrance... why was it so familiar?

Chen Ji desperately tried to trace the source in his memory, but only felt a string in his mind strain to the point of snapping. The figure's outline in the mist constantly distorted in his vision—sometimes slender as a woman, sometimes tall as a man, utterly bizarre.

dialogue.content:
'Impossible... I strategized for seven hundred chapters, left nothing to chance, how could I die so miserably!'

Chen Ji howled from the depths of his consciousness, his fists clenched so tight his nails dug deep into his palms. The sharp pain反而 brought him a thread of clarity. He forced himself to calm down, and like an instinct honed through countless life-and-death crises, began analyzing everything before him.

The location, time, and cause of death—these were all clearly visible. Only the figure standing beside the corpse became the greatest mystery in the prophecy.

text.content:
Just then, an elderly yet familiar voice rang out in the depths of his Mental Sea—that was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, carrying centuries of vicissitudes and helplessness.

'Do you see it? The finale of Chapter 700 is exactly like this.'

Mo Xiansheng's voice came from an extremely distant place, each word carrying an indescribable weight: 'Did you think the Tianji Record was a tool to change your fate? Child, it has merely calculated your time of death down to every breath.'

Chen Ji abruptly looked up, howling within his consciousness: 'Then tell me! How do I gather the seven seals? Where is the clue to breaking the heavenly chess game!'

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment—that silence was more despair-inducing than any words. Finally, he slowly spoke: 'Prophecy will not give you answers, it only gives you fear. But one thing is certain—'

His voice suddenly turned sharp: 'That figure standing beside your corpse... on them remains the aura of the first seal of the Tianji Record.'

These words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's mind.

The aura of the first seal of the Tianji Record? Could that mean... that person also holds a fragment of the Tianji Record?

Chen Ji desperately tried to grasp this clue, yet at this moment sensed a familiar spiritual fluctuation coming from a distant direction—that was the unique cold aura of demonic path mist.

Simultaneously, another strand of pure spiritual energy, as clean as snow mountain spring, also pierced through his chaotic divine sense—that was... Chen Nian?

His sister, shouldn't she be in the Holy Sect's hands? How could she possibly...

choice.prompt: Chen Ji, you stand at the edge of fate's cliff. The Tianji Record aura on that shadowy figure is the only clue, but your Mental Sea is collapsing—you must make a choice.

choices.description: At all costs, even if the Mental Sea collapses, must see that person's true face. This is the only key to unraveling all mysteries.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate -15, Mental Sea severely injured
choices.visible_reward: May see the figure's true face, obtain crucial clues

text.content:
Chen Ji gritted his teeth, condensing all his divine sense into an invisible spear, thrusting directly toward the figure in the mist. A tearing pain came from the depths of his Mental Sea, blood began seeping from his seven apertures, but he did not retreat.

That figure seemed to sense something—a hand slowly extended from within the mist—

dialogue.content: 'No matter who you are... I will find you!'

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the fear and reluctance churning within him. He knew too well—carelessly tracking in this situation would only cause his Mental Sea to collapse prematurely.

He closed his eyes, focusing all his attention on the prophecy text he had originally ignored. 'Only by gathering the seven seals of the Tianji Record can the heavenly chess game be broken'—every word in this sentence began rearranging and combining in his mind.

dialogue.content: 'Seven layers... not a quantity, but a vessel. The seals themselves are a type of power container.' Chen Ji murmured to himself, a flash of insight flickering in his eyes.

choices.text: Pull consciousness back to reality to seek help
choices.description: His Mental Sea was already overwhelmed. Forcing a trace would be too dangerous. Return to reality first and let Ye Qing and Chen Nian help stabilize his state.
choices.visible_reward: Safely return to reality, gaining ally support.
choices.risk_hint: Allies may not arrive in time.

text.content:
Chen Ji made the most rational yet most difficult decision—he actively severed the connection with that figure, pulling his consciousness from the abyss of prophecy.

Intense pain struck him; he felt as if hurled from miles above the ground. But just as he was about to lose consciousness, two familiar forces appeared at the edge of his divine sense like a lifeline.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji! Give your consciousness to me!" Ye Qing's voice carried rare urgency, and the Demonic Path mist gently cradled his chaotic divine sense like a tender palm.

text.content:
Meanwhile, beyond the distant horizon.

Chen Nian abruptly woke from meditation, her young yet matured face filled with panic. Her hands tightly clutched her chest, where waves of agonizing pain were radiating—the backlash of Blood Pulse resonance.

"Brother..." she whispered, tears uncontrollably streaming down her face.

She sensed it. In that distant unknown place, her elder brother was experiencing some crisis sufficient to destroy his soul.

Without hesitation, Chen Nian activated the power of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key within her. A brilliant golden light shot from her Brow Center, piercing through layers of spatial barriers and directly stabbing into Chen Ji's chaotic Mental Sea.

The Heavenly Fate Lock Key power, originally the shackles the Holy Sect used to imprison her, now became a bridge connecting her and her brother.

The golden light converged with the Demonic Path mist within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. These two utterly different forces did not conflict; instead, like long-separated friends reuniting, they together wove a delicate net that steadily supported his tottering soul.

In that brief moment of tranquility, Chen Ji finally perceived another layer of meaning within the prophecy.

"Seven layers of seals... not seven components, but seven transformations." His consciousness cleared like parting clouds to reveal the sun, various clues connecting into a coherent line in his mind.

Each layer of the Tianji Record's seal corresponded to an awakening of power. From the first layer's "Foresight," to the second layer's "Tampering," to the current fragmented state... he had traveled too far.

And the seventh layer of seals should be—"Reversal."

Only by reversing cause and effect itself could one break the deadly game heaven had set.

Fragments of memory flashed before his eyes—a rainy night, a back view, some forgotten whisper...

Suddenly, the image froze.
He saw a blurry outline—that was...

text.content:
Chen Ji made an experienced decision. He gathered his focus, allowing Ye Qing and Chen Nian's forces to guide his consciousness back to reality.

Before his consciousness completely departed from the prophecy's vision, he took one last look at that blurry figure, then—

Turned and left.

"I will return," he silently pledged in his heart, "bringing power sufficient to overturn everything."

dialogue.content: "Awake?" Ye Qing's face appeared in his vision, those enchanting purple pupils expressing rare worry, "You almost fried your own brain just now."

text.content:
Chen Ji suddenly laughed. It was a cold smile that grew even more manic in the face of despair.

「Since you've appeared in my death prophecy, you might as well hear what I have to say—」

His voice pierced through the barrier of prophecy, striking directly at the figure in the mist: 「Next time you stand beside my corpse, remember to check if I've stopped breathing first. Chen Ji... has played dead more than once.」

The blurry figure seemed to freeze for a moment.

Chen Ji clearly saw—the layer of mist rippled slightly, like a stone thrown into a calm lake.

He knew he had won the bet. This person... knew him. And hearing his name, was shaken.

Meanwhile, deep within the Tianqing Sect.

In Ling Yuan's secret chamber for closed-door cultivation, the candlelight flickered. His withered fingers slowly turned the pages of a yellowed ancient scroll, while those murky old eyes gleamed with a sharpness entirely at odds with his appearance.

Suddenly, his fingers stopped.

「Interesting...」 he murmured to himself, a meaningful smile appearing on his aged face, 「So he can see that far. It seems this 'trash martial nephew' of mine... is more worthy of attention than I imagined.」

Ling Yuan closed the ancient book and stood up. He slowly walked toward the depths of the secret chamber, where an ancient bronze mirror stood enshrined.

The mirror's surface rippled with light, reflecting not his withered face, but—some blurry figure, standing amidst chaos.

「The heavens' fate is about to change.」 Ling Yuan murmured, his tone carrying both anticipation and an inexplicable jealousy, 「The Tianji Record chose you, but it doesn't know what it has chosen—the next sacrifice.」

He reached out to stroke the mirror's surface, and the figure within suddenly turned its head—the face beneath the mist bore a startling seven-tenths resemblance to Ling Yuan.

Meanwhile, in the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds.

Chen Nian's eyes snapped open to find herself firmly bound to the altar by dozens of chains. The power of the golden Heavenly Fate Key had been exhausted, and before her stood a mysterious figure cloaked in black.

「What did you just do?」 The black-robed figure's voice was ice-cold, 「Daring to contact the outside world privately... Do you think these chains are for decoration?」

Chen Nian defiantly lifted her chin, though blood trickled from the corner of her mouth, her gaze firm as iron: 「I want to save my brother.」

The black-robed figure fell silent for a moment, then suddenly sneered: 「Save him? Little girl, do you know who that figure standing beside your 'dear brother's' corpse in his death prophecy actually is?」

Chen Nian's heart sank heavily.

「That is the embodiment of the Heavenly Eye.」 The black-robed figure slowly said, 「It will descend at the final moment, personally harvesting the lives of all who resist. Your brother... is merely a discarded piece on its chessboard. And you—」

He bent down, his withered fingers gripping Chen Nian's chin: 「You are the key, the bridge, the sacrifice for Heaven's descent into the mortal world. From the moment you were born, fate was already written.」

text.content:
Chen Ji sat cross-legged, forcing himself into the coldest state of analysis. Ye Qing stood guard silently beside him, the Demonic Path mist weaving a barrier around them, cutting off all prying eyes.

He arranged all the intelligence in his mind—Heavenly Eye, death prophecy, seven layers of seals, that blurry figure...

「Wait.」 He suddenly opened his eyes, 「That figure's aura... it's not just the first layer of the Tianji Record.」

dialogue.content: 「There's the second layer... the third layer's aura! That person has at least fragments of the Tianji Record fragments!」 Chen Ji abruptly lifted his head, his eyes blazing with a wild light, 「The Heavenly Eye isn't using the Tianji Record—it itself... is part of the Tianji Record!」

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, tracing Chen Nian's location along the lingering resonance of their blood connection. In his Mental Sea, countless images flashed like a carousel—finally freezing on a dark underground space.

Altar, chains, black-robed figure...

「Holy Sect.」 Chen Ji's voice turned ice-cold, and in those eyes that usually carried three parts timidity, there now burned a fury sufficient to incinerate everything.

dialogue.content: "I remember." He murmured, his tone terrifyingly calm. "Holy Sect. I remember."

text.content:
Ye Qing sensed his violent emotional fluctuation, frowning slightly: "Are you going to save her?"

Chen Ji didn't answer, but the killing intent that exploded in that instant explained everything.

choices.text: Interrogating Mo Xiansheng About the Truth
choices.description: This guardian knows far more than he's revealed—it's time to force him to tell the whole truth.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng May Set Up a Test

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath and proactively activated the residual consciousness on the first page of the Tianji Record. Mo Xiansheng's aged face reappeared in the depths of his Mental Sea, those profound eyes still carrying a hint of enigmatic smiles.

"Ask." Mo Xiansheng seemed to have long anticipated his arrival. "Old one knows, you've been holding this in for quite some time."

Chen Ji stared directly into those eyes, speaking word by word: "What exactly is the Eye of Heavenly Secrets?"

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng fell into a long silence. When he spoke again, his voice carried an ancient desolation spanning millennia: "It was the first master of the Tianji Record—or rather, the precursor of the Tianji Record."

"In ancient times, there was a prodigiously talented seer who wished to glimpse the complete face of Heaven's Way. So he used himself as a furnace, smelting a treasure capable of foresee ing the future—that became the embryonic form of the Tianji Record."

text.content:
"However, knowing the future comes at a price. Each glimpse brought that seer closer to Heaven's Way, and further from 'humanity'. Finally, one day, his consciousness completely merged with Heaven's Way, transforming into—the Eye of Heavenly Secrets."

Mo Xiansheng's voice grew heavy: "From then on, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets used the Tianji Record as a medium to search for the next 'vessel' in the mortal realm. Chen Xuan was a candidate. Your father was a candidate. And you... are also a candidate."

Chen Ji listened, long speechless.

He had always believed he was struggling against fate, never expecting—he himself was part of fate. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets, the Tianji Record, the seer... these formed a death loop spanning ten thousand years.

And he was merely the newest node in this cycle.

"What about my father?" he asked hoarsely. "He... was also a candidate?"

Mo Xiansheng's gaze flickered with complex emotions: "Yes. But before awakening, he chose another path—sealing the Tianji Record, passing down the bloodline, and then... ending his own life."

These words struck Chen Ji's heart like a heavy hammer.

He recalled his father's final gaze—not simple abandonment, but a mercy bordering on cruelty. He severed the awakening trigger within the bloodline through death, yet hid the Tianji Record Fragment in the Chen family ancestral hall, waiting for the right moment.

"He was protecting me." Chen Ji murmured. "Trading his life for my twenty years of peace."

But now, twenty years have passed. The gears of fate can no longer be stopped.

Mo Xiansheng sighed: "Your father was a wise man, but he underestimated the Tianji Record's obsession. It waited too long and will never let go of any awakening seed."

He gazed at Chen Ji, those ancient eyes seeming to reflect a future both predetermined yet changeable: "Child, you still have a choice. Accept becoming the vessel, to be devoured by Heaven's Way on the day of the final reckoning; or..."

"Or what?"

"Break the cycle." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly rose high. "Make the seer vanish completely, turn the Tianji Record into a truly inanimate object—rather than its current state, a living thing that treats everyone as chess pieces."

Chen Ji fell silent.

Breaking the cycle—what did that mean? Destroying the Tianji Record entirely? Or... destroying the Eye of Heavenly Secrets?

He suddenly recalled the scene in the death prophecy—himself fallen in a pool of blood, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets descending from a crack into the mortal realm. If that prophecy was real, then the key to breaking the cycle might be hidden within that final reckoning.

"Seven layers of seal, seven transformations." He murmured. "The seventh layer is reversal... reversal of what? Reversing cause and effect? Reversing life and death? Or—reversing fate itself?"

Mo Xiansheng gave no answer. He merely cast a meaningful glance at Chen Ji, then slowly dissipated into the depths of his Mental Sea.

But before disappearing, he said something that sent chills down Chen Ji's spine:

"That figure standing beside your corpse—have you ever wondered why you can't see his face?"

"Because... that's something that hasn't happened yet?" Chen Ji ventured.

Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed from the void, carrying a strange smile: "No, child. It's because—that person is currently sharing the same body with you."

As the words fell, silence completely returned to the Mental Sea.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, finding himself back in reality. Ye Qing was watching him with concern, and in the distance—a familiar figure was approaching quickly.

It was Su Qingyao.

Her complexion was poor; she had clearly sensed the刚才的异常 as well. Those cold, clear eyes held worry, but also an undeniable hint of accusation.

"Chen Ji." She stood before him, her voice calm yet chilly. "You just... used the Tianji Record again?"

Chen Ji raised his head, meeting her gaze.

In that moment, he suddenly realized—Su Qingyao, this woman who had been investigating him in secret, might be the only person capable of accompanying him to the final reckoning.

But her fate... would she be willing to be drawn into this chess game that could devour everything?

dialogue.content:
"No matter how many times you ask, the answer remains the same." Chen Ji slowly rose to his feet, a bitter smile tugging at his lips. "I just... saw my own death."

Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply.

"Chapter seven hundred." Chen Ji said softly. "Seven hundred chapters away."

He turned to gaze into the distance—that direction where the three great sects converged—his deadly ground, the starting point of Heaven's Way's descent.

"But I have seven hundred chapters to rewrite this ending."

text.content:
Ye Qing and Su Qingyao exchanged a glance, both seeing the same emotion in each other's eyes—shock, heartache, and an indescribable determination.

They might not fully understand what "Heaven's Way chess game" meant in Chen Ji's words, but one thing was certain—

This man was single-handedly confronting some terrifying existence beyond everyone's imagination.

And they chose to stand by his side.

In the distance, that blurry figure still shrouded in mist seemed to sense something. It slowly turned its head—

Beneath the mist, a pair of eyes identical to Chen Ji's could be faintly seen.
